exposure: Retained partial or complete placenta at a previous delivery
outcome: Reoccurrence of retained partial or complete placenta in a subsequent delivery
Retained partial or complete placenta and/or postpartum hemorrhage in a subsequent delivery
cohort: The study longitudinally followed women who had a vaginal delivery complicated by a partial or complete retained placenta (study group, n=90) and women who did not (control group, n=90) at Edith Wolfson Medical Center.
finding: Retained partial or complete placenta at an index delivery significantly increases the risk of reoccurrence of retained partial or complete placenta and/or postpartum hemorrhage in a subsequent delivery.
